seed_data.title: Mekabu Hydrating Shampoo
seed_data.description:
MASAMI Mekabu Hydrating Shampoo's nutrient-rich formulation fortifies and reawakens hair. Apricot oil, coconut oil and laminaria japonica (kombu) provide nutrients and vitamins important for healthy hair. MASAMI Shampoo is the ultimate in botanical hydration for hair and nourishment for the scalp. Great for any hair type and texture -- anyone who wants salon hair every day without weighing hair down.

Our low foam formula keeps hair hydrated between washes. You don't need to use a lot to see the benefits -- and thanks to our botanically hydrating formulas, you'll find you won't have to wash your hair as often.

seed_data.title: Mekabu Hydrating Conditioner
seed_data.description:
MASAMI's Mekabu Hydrating Conditioner is fortified by the hydrating qualities of the Japanese ocean botanical Mekabu, and enhanced with Laminaria Japonica (Kombu) seaweed, aloe vera, blueberry extract, Vitamin B and other powerful anti-oxidants. This deep yet lightweight conditioner nourishes to restore softness, shine and manageability while soothing the scalp, all without weighing hair down. This conditioner won't leave hair feeling greasy or heavy, just botanically hydrated, smooth and soft.

Great for every hair type and texture -- and anyone who wants salon hair every day. If your hair is dry, brittle, frizzy or colored, this is for you.

Waves and curls love it too, from 2a to 4c hair.

seed_data.title: Mekabu Hydrating Shine Serum
seed_data.description:

Our Shine Serum works on virtually every hair type and texture to enhance shine while leaving hair soft and silky. It adds vibrancy to hair color while providing the nutrients necessary for long term nourishment and care. Great for any hair type and texture - anyone who wants salon hair every day. 

Size: 1.7oz, now in a glass bottle

seed_data.title: Mekabu Hydrating Styling Cream
seed_data.description:
Mekabu and Aloe Vera add hydration, protection and shine, while Vitamin E, Grapeseed, and Sweet Almond Oils help nourish the hair from root to tip, eliminating frizz for a natural, soft, silky look.

This curl-defining formula is non-greasy, non-sticky and boasts the benefits of a wax, paste and cream for a flexible, all-day hold, that can be messy, sleek or anything in between. Use on wet or dry hair.

seed_data.pdp_how_to_use_raw: For best results: Apply as a styling aid after shampooing and conditioning with MASAMI. Rub a small amount between your palms and work through damp or dry hair. For continuous hydration, use daily.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Ingredients
pdp_details_sections.body: Water, Grapeseed Oil, Cetearyl Alcohol (non drying, helps soften the hair and retain moisture), Glycerin (derived from plants, helps attract & retain moisture), Glyceryl Stearate SE (keeps hair from drying out and becoming damaged), Glyceryl Stearate (traps moisture), Stearic Acid (protects and conditions), Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate (natural surfactant derived from coconut oil, corn and fruit sugars), Isopropyl Palmitate (vegan emollient and thickener), Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Peg-40 Castor Oil, Xanthan Gum (thickener), Panthenol (moisturizing compound), Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E), Undaria Pinnatifida (Mekabu) Powder, Macrocystis Pyrifera (Kelp) Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Maltodextrin/VP Copolymer (helps define curls and reduce frizz), Dehydroacetic Acid (mild preservative), Benzyl Alcohol (preservative and stabilizer), Fragrance (our fragrance is naturally derived and phthalate-free).

pdp_details_sections.heading: How to use
pdp_details_sections.body: For best results: Apply as a styling aid after shampooing and conditioning with MASAMI. Rub a small amount between your palms and work through damp or dry hair. For continuous hydration, use daily.
